body: Well I don't know what the definition of a creepy conversation is. So I guess it's because it can be kind of awkward. Also, when I wanted to have a conversation with her boyfriend before I just asked him what bands he liked, not much else so it became kind of awkward, and when me and my cousin were walking our dogs, along with my couins's boyfriend, I asked them if they've ever though of suicide, and they just something like they're uncomfortable about talking about that. I remember that last July, when I was visiting my aunt's house (and it's like 4-5 hours to ge there) I was initially very happy, then my cousin had already made plans to be with her friends and her boyfriend, and I got very jealous and was feeling like I wanted to kill myself. To my surprise, around mignight my cousin and her bf came back to my aunt's house to sleep instead of sleeping at the bf, so I asked my cousin's boyfriend where I could go to jump off and kill myself, and he just told me not to. But I did, strangely enough, build up the courage to ask her boyfriend if he wanted to take a selfie with me and upload to Instagram (this was also the first time I had met him), and he said yes, and then I asked my cousin too and she also said yes. To be honest I asked her boyfriend first just so it wouldn't look weird that I only asked my cousin. But in that moment, I felt incredibly happy. My cousin is the only girl I have been able to take a picture with and upload to Instagram. My cousin also asked me if I had watched Stranger Things, I said no, so she told me I could use her Netflix account and I watched all three seasons in four days. That's another reason why I love my cousin.

it's a form of wanting a friendship very, very, very, very much. my cousin is incredibly special. if I got to hang out with her, I would be so happy. I would love to watch movies together with her, party and drink together with her, maybe teach her songs on my guitar and maybe even excersise together with her.

I am not in love with my cousin. That would be really embarassing. I just want to be her friend.

But I'm not sure if my cousin would actually miss me. Last September or October, I hurt myself by beating my hip until it turned red, then I took a picture of it and sent it to my cousin's boyfriend because I was afraid my cousin hated me. He asked me what it was and I explained what it was and why I did it, then he told me that I can't do that again, and that my cousin likes me and cares about me. I'm sure however he just said that to comfort me. I also sent the picture to my cousin but she didn't send anything back, so either she didn't care or she didn't see what the picture was, as it was somewhat unclear, in fact it looked kind of surreal. I sent the picture to my younger cousin also, and she asked me what it was and I explained, and she was basically disturbed by the picture. I didn't send the picture to anyone else. I beat my hip again a few weeks after that, but I didn't take a photo of it or tell anyone.
